description: Source code for the Intel e1000 Ethernet driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, packet transmission, reception, interrupt handling, and optional PTP clock support.

methods.name: e1000_reg_to_string
methods.description: Converts register enum to string for debugging.

methods.name: get_iface
methods.description: Retrieves network interface, considering VLAN configuration.

methods.name: e1000_caps
methods.description: Returns the hardware capabilities of the Ethernet device.

methods.name: e1000_get_ptp_clock
methods.description: Returns the PTP clock device associated with the Ethernet device.

methods.name: e1000_send
methods.description: Prepares and sends a network packet.

methods.name: e1000_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for handling Ethernet device interrupts.

methods.name: e1000_probe
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet device, sets up PCI configuration and descriptors.

methods.name: e1000_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address and links device.
